summary.text: Cal Bahr, listed by Ballotpedia as Calvin Bahr, is the Republican incumbent state senator for Minnesota State Senate District 31 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election against Democrat Gadisa Berkessa.

A business owner and truck driver from East Bethel, he served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023, and the Minnesota Senate's member directory lists Calvin K. Bahr as a Republican representing District 31.

paragraphs.text: Calvin Bahr lives in East Bethel, Minnesota, and his career experience includes working as a business owner and truck driver, according to Ballotpedia.
Bahr served in Minnesota House District 31B from 2017 to 2023 and was re-elected to that seat in 2018 and 2020.
In 2022 he won Minnesota State Senate District 31, defeating Jason Ruffalo with 63.7 percent of the vote after winning the Republican primary over Maribella McDermid, in a race without an incumbent.
He assumed office in the Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Michelle Benson.
In 2025-2026 Bahr was assigned to the Elections Committee and the Local Government Committee.
His 2026 Republican primary was canceled, and Ballotpedia lists endorsements from the Minnesota Chamber Leadership Fund PAC and the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) Minnesota PAC.
